definitions.explanation: A formal written document submitted to one's employer to officially notify them of one's intention to resign. In Japan, this is a binding notification that cannot be withdrawn once accepted.

examples.japanese: {退職届|たいしょくとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I submitted my letter of resignation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I submitted my resignation letter to my boss.

examples.japanese: {退職届|たいしょくとどけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦{希望日|きぼうび}→希望日：27384_kiboubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一|いっ}か{月前|げつまえ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit your resignation letter at least one month before your desired departure date.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal document in the Japanese workplace. Distinguished from ⟦{退職願|たいしょくねがい}→退職願：28562_taishokunegai⟧, which is a request to resign (and can theoretically be refused or withdrawn). A {退職届|たいしょくとどけ} is a definitive notification and is generally irrevocable once submitted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {退職届|たいしょくとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to submit a resignation letter)
- {退職届|たいしょくとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ (to submit a resignation letter, formal)
- {退職届|たいしょくとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受理|じゅり}→受理：12032_juri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to accept a resignation letter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{退職願|たいしょくねがい}→退職願：28562_taishokunegai⟧: resignation request (can be withdrawn; a request rather than a notification)
- ⟦{辞表|じひょう}→辞表：27086_jihyou⟧: letter of resignation (used by executives and public officials)
